name: advance_build_state
summary: Build a placed structure on to a later build state, paying each state's materials from from_id (default the player) as a player's construction does. Dry run by default; confirm to build. Cheat with free.

help.text: to_state defaults to the next state; the last state is complete. A damaged structure is refused, as the game refuses it. Tools a state uses are listed but not needed or worn. find_things, thing_health and describe_device give build_state {current, last, complete, next} for a structure.

reply.text: {dry_run, thing, from_state, to_state, last_state, cost [{prefab_name, display_name, quantity, available, paid_by}], tools [{prefab_name, display_name, tool}], ready, problems, build_state}. available is what the sources hold (null with free); build_state is read back after a real run.

refusals.summary: Why a structure is not built on.
refusals.text: no_build_states (not a structure with two or more states), already_complete, structure_broken (its broken state), structure_damaged (repair it first), not_enough_materials (a real run; a dry run lists problems), not_creative (free outside creative), no_local_player (no player to pay; give from_id).

to_state.description: The build state to reach; default the next one.

free.description: Creative worlds only: take no materials. Default false.
